cases.name: Feed and sign-in reject unauthenticated requests
SMS code login and token authentication for three independent users
Follow, duplicate follow and common follows use consistent SQL and Redis data
Publishing uses authenticated author and fans receive all seven posts
Feed HTTP cursor pagination has no duplicates or omissions across equal timestamps
Like, unlike, liker list and feed viewer state agree with persisted counts
Unfollow stops delivery of future posts while other fans still receive them
Sign-in is idempotent and user-isolated; consecutive count requires today
Shop detail uses generic cache, update invalidation, negative caching and GEO
